reviews.t: STAY AWAY FROM THIS PRODUCT...DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.x: Very disappointed in this product.  The description says it cures in 30 seconds, but I held my nails under the light for over 4 minutes and they are still tacky. I applied thin coats as directed, but it didn't matter.  My nails took forever to dry. I would not recommend this product and I feel like I wasted my money. My daughter will be disappointed when I tell her we can't do her nails because it takes longer to dry than regular polish.  I would not recommend anyone buying this product and wast

reviews.t: BUY BUY BUY YOU WILL LOVE IT!!

I FOLLOWED INSTRUCTIONS AS IT SAYS, I WIPED NAILS WITH ALCOHOL, PAINTED NAILS DID 1 BASE COAT 3 NAIL COLOR COATS AND 1 TOP COAT SET AT 60 SECONDS EACH SESSION. THEY CAME OUT SO WELL FOR NOT BEING A PROFESSIONAL. I WILL NOT GO TO A SALON TO DO THEM AGAIN. THE CUTICLE OIL I LOVE IT MADE SURE TO PUT SOME OF THAT ON.  PROS- DRIES AFTER EACH 60 SECOND CURE SUPER CUTE COLORS COMES WITH CUTICLE NAIL PU
Polishes are a little small but overall I am happy with my purchase so far.

Great product! I am very pleased with the product I received. The UV lamp is great & can easily dry a full hand at a time. The colors are fun. I am happy with all the accessories as well - nail files, gems, nail glue, cuticle pusher, cuticle cutter, cuticle oil... Also, I am able to really cute, fun nails for my daughters. I would highly recommend this product, especially for the price!

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY - WASTE OF MONEY
reviews.x: This product is terrible. The polish was clumpy. The polish would not cure. I left it under the light for 20 mins and it was tacky. I am so disappointed. Can't even return because it has to be sent back to China. By the time I get done paying to ship it back, I will end up losing money.

I first tried the teal / turquoise color and it has thick sluggish pieces in, so I closed the bottle shook it again and 2 nails later get the same result. It says use the base coat polish then top coat.  I followed the instructions to the letter but was and am very disappointed in the product.

reviews.t: This is not your nail salon but it does work.

All I could think was how am I going to get this sticky , gunky stuff off of my nails. But I just kept pushing forward and putting on the next step and low and behold the top coat seem to do the trick. I put it on and then dried them for 120 seconds and it was done. reviews.t: Pleased with the outcome for the value

It came with a good bit of items to help you prep your nails and multiple colors of fingernail polish.  There was two different sets of directions, one for the light and one for the application of the gel polish. But I still had to look up the directions on how long I needed to keep the light on my nails because this wasnt specified. Make sure you shake the fingernail polish up well before you u

Horrible horrible horrible. I am DEVASTATED. I had such nice, healthy, strong nails and this product DESTROYED my nails. After use, my nails are thin, they split, break easily AND actually disconnected from my nail beds AND NOW my nail beds are growing with my nails. My nails take forever to grow now.  My nail got caught on my sweater and actually tore the top half of my nail off...and I didn't feel a THING. that's how dead it was.  The polish itself would take forever to set and would peel off

Great value and kit, however the colors are not accurately represented. Nails were quite tacky at first, but dry-they're fine. My 1st time using gel and uv light. I dried them for the longest time ever- due to tackiness. I started prepping my nails before 8pm and finished sometime after 11pm. Can't complain regardless of colors. Comes with base and top coats too- which is great!! I've seen just lights cost more. Plus "LED" uv lights are the best according to my research. Best of luck- enjoy!

reviews.t: Lots of products inside but not worth it
reviews.x: Polishes are not good at all . The Uv light either was not drying my nails Or it was the polishes . The right kind of instructions was not in this package either for the light it's three different settings . I've used one before so I know it's not this difficult to dry the nails I was just trying to find another justification  as to why it wasn't working correctly . I went on and gave it to my daughters for them to play with n ordered another

claims.text: Many reviewers report the gel polish fails to cure properly, staying tacky even after extended time under the UV lamp.
Several reviewers complain the polish is thick, clumpy, or hard to work with.
Some reviewers praise the UV lamp and overall kit as good value for the price.
A few reviewers note the polish flakes or peels off quickly.
Some reviewers mention return difficulties because the product ships from China.
